name: Kakehashi Association
description: Kakehashi Association — a theme for a community support association (home visits, a food and clothing bank, language help, an open table), built around a notice feed: a formal white top header with the association's name, the office hours and a Become a member button, the main menu in one row on the right. Nadeshiko pink (#DC9FB4) is the main colour: the full-height purpose banner on the left of the first screen, the take-part field, the page heads and the mobile menu are pink. The front page opens on a narrow vertical banner with the association's purpose in one Shippori Mincho sentence and a cut-out photograph of a paper-cut sculpture (two hands holding a small bridge) that breaks out over the banner edge; beside it, the notice board: category tabs (All, Events, Support, Volunteers, Reports) that filter seven dated notice rows without JavaScript, and Become a member / Donate links. Below: the pinned important notice in a pale box, six programmes as a two-column text index, this month's events as a date list with large day numbers, three ways to take part on a pink field where cut-out clasped hands break over the top edge, a documents download list and a short about with a collage of three overlapping photographs. Photographs are realistic film-grain images (35mm look, 50mm f/2, natural side light, graded toward nadeshiko pink). Shippori Mincho B1 for headings, Source Sans 3 for text. Sample content in English. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
